title: Cabinet (CCEA, 11 Nov 2026) approves ₹3,230 crore for the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at North and South Block, New Delhi (cost appraised by the Public Investment Board); first gallery (Adornment) due in North Block in late 2027; phased build FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31; built for 1 crore visitors a year; ~18 lakh objects identified; Vaishnaw: world's largest display area; PMO moved to Seva Teerth Feb 2026
